title: AI SQL functions
about: The AIDB functions documented in the EDB docs, by docs section. Only these functions are listed.

groups.name: AI SQL functions
groups.description: Use the standalone SQL functions in AIDB for chunking, parsing, OCR, summarization, PII detection, AI inference, and reranking. Call them directly in SQL queries or use them as building blocks in custom AI workflows.

sections.name: Chunking
sections.description: Splitting text into segments for LLM context windows

functions.name: aidb.chunk_text
functions.summary: Divides a text string into smaller, semantically coherent segments.

sections.name: Parsing
sections.description: Extracting readable text from HTML and PDF inputs

functions.name: aidb.parse_html
functions.summary: Extracts readable text from an HTML string, stripping tags while preserving structure.

functions.name: aidb.parse_pdf
functions.summary: Extracts text from binary PDF data.

sections.name: OCR
sections.description: Extracting text from images using an OCR-capable model

functions.name: aidb.perform_ocr
functions.summary: Extracts text from image data using a registered OCR-capable model.

sections.name: Summarization
sections.description: Generating and aggregating AI-powered text summaries

functions.name: aidb.summarize_text
functions.summary: Generates a concise summary of a text string using a registered language model.

functions.name: aidb.summarize_text_aggregate
functions.summary: Aggregate version of `aidb.summarize_text`.

sections.name: PII detection
sections.description: Finding and redacting personal data in text

functions.name: aidb.pii_extract
functions.summary: Finds PII spans in a text string using a registered `onnx_token_classifier` model.

functions.name: aidb.pii_extract_batch
functions.summary: Batch version of `aidb.pii_extract`.

functions.name: aidb.pii_redact
functions.summary: Replaces each PII span in a text string with a placeholder.

functions.name: aidb.pii_redact_batch
functions.summary: Batch version of `aidb.pii_redact`.

sections.name: Encoding and generating
sections.description: Embedding text and images into vectors and generating text completions

functions.name: aidb.encode_text
functions.summary: Encodes a single text string into a vector using the specified model.

functions.name: aidb.encode_text_batch
functions.summary: Encodes an array of text strings into vectors in a single call.

functions.name: aidb.encode_text_query
functions.summary: Encodes a search query into a vector using the model's query encoding.

functions.name: aidb.encode_text_query_batch
functions.summary: Encodes an array of search queries into vectors in a single call.

functions.name: aidb.encode_image
functions.summary: Encodes a binary image into a vector using a multimodal model (for example, CLIP).

functions.name: aidb.generate_text
functions.summary: Generates a text response from a prompt using the specified model.

functions.name: aidb.generate_text_batch
functions.summary: Generates text responses for an array of prompts in a single call.

sections.name: Reranking
sections.description: Scoring and reordering candidate passages by relevance

functions.name: aidb.rerank_text
functions.summary: Scores and ranks a set of text inputs against a query using a reranking model.

groups.name: Models
groups.description: API reference for AIDB model management, inference functions, and model configuration helpers.

functions.name: aidb.create_model
functions.summary: Registers a new model in the AIDB model registry.

functions.name: aidb.get_model
functions.summary: Returns the configuration for a registered model.

functions.name: aidb.delete_model
functions.summary: Removes a model from the registry.

functions.name: aidb.validate_model
functions.summary: Probes a registered model to confirm it's functional, running a minimal test inference.

functions.name: aidb.create_credential
functions.summary: Creates a credential.

functions.name: aidb.create_aws_credential
functions.summary: Creates a credential for models that sign requests with the PostgreSQL server's AWS credentials.

functions.name: aidb.update_credential
functions.summary: Changes a credential's secret, endpoint, or sharing.

functions.name: aidb.delete_credential
functions.summary: Deletes a credential and its secret.

functions.name: aidb.validate_endpoint_pattern
functions.summary: Checks an endpoint pattern and returns it in normalized form.

functions.name: aidb.endpoint_host
functions.summary: Returns the host a model of the given provider calls for the given URL.

functions.name: aidb.list_hcp_models
functions.summary: Lists models currently running on HM.

functions.name: aidb.create_hcp_model
functions.summary: Registers an HCP-hosted model by referencing its running instance name.

functions.name: aidb.sync_hcp_models
functions.summary: Synchronizes the AIDB model registry with models currently running on HCP.

functions.name: aidb.aws_default_credentials
functions.summary: Returns the config keys that make a model sign its requests with the PostgreSQL server's AWS credentials instead of an API key.

functions.name: aidb.embeddings_config
functions.summary: For `openai_embeddings` and any OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint.

functions.name: aidb.completions_config
functions.summary: For `openai_completions` and any OpenAI-compatible completions endpoint.

functions.name: aidb.max_tokens_config
functions.summary: Builds the `max_tokens` object for use with `aidb.completions_config()`.

functions.name: aidb.bert_config
functions.summary: For the `bert_local` provider.

functions.name: aidb.clip_config
functions.summary: For the `clip_local` provider.

functions.name: aidb.llama_config
functions.summary: For the `llama_instruct_local` provider.

functions.name: aidb.t5_config
functions.summary: For the `t5_local` provider.

functions.name: aidb.gemini_config
functions.summary: For the `gemini` provider.

functions.name: aidb.nim_clip_config
functions.summary: For the `nim_clip` provider (NVIDIA NIM multimodal embeddings).

functions.name: aidb.nim_ocr_config
functions.summary: For the `nim_paddle_ocr` provider (NVIDIA NIM OCR).

functions.name: aidb.nim_reranking_config
functions.summary: For the `nim_reranking` provider.

functions.name: aidb.openrouter_chat_config
functions.summary: For the `openrouter_chat` provider.

functions.name: aidb.openrouter_embeddings_config
functions.summary: For the `openrouter_embeddings` provider.

functions.name: aidb.openai_responses_config
functions.summary: For the `openai_responses` and `openai_responses_azure` providers.

functions.name: aidb.anthropic_messages_config
functions.summary: For the `anthropic_messages`, `anthropic_messages_azure`, and `anthropic_messages_bedrock` providers.

groups.name: Knowledge bases
groups.description: API reference for AIDB knowledge base views, retrieval functions, volume management, and auto-processing configuration.

functions.name: aidb.retrieve_key
functions.summary: Returns the source record keys and distances for the top matching embeddings, without fetching source data.

functions.name: aidb.retrieve_text
functions.summary: Returns source text and distances for the top matching embeddings by joining the embeddings table with the source table.

functions.name: aidb.delete_knowledge_base
functions.summary: Cascades: deletes all pipelines attached to the knowledge base, drops the vector table, and removes the registry entry.

functions.name: aidb.create_volume
functions.summary: Creates an AIDB volume from a PGFS storage location.

functions.name: aidb.delete_volume
functions.summary: Deletes an AIDB volume.

groups.name: Semantic knowledge bases
groups.description: API reference for AIDB semantic knowledge base functions — creating and managing a KB, relationships, comment curation, search, and health checks.

sections.name: Creating and managing a semantic KB

functions.name: aidb.create_semantic_kb
functions.summary: Creates a semantic KB over one or more schemas, embeds the schema metadata with the given model, and crawls the schemas immediately.

functions.name: aidb.list_semantic_kbs
functions.summary: Lists every semantic KB with its model, schemas, and processing mode.

functions.name: aidb.refresh_semantic_kb
functions.summary: Re-crawls a KB's schemas from scratch to pick up structural changes, and republishes the KB's managed agent plugin and its tools.

functions.name: aidb.update_semantic_kb_auto_processing
functions.summary: Changes how a KB reacts to schema changes after creation.

functions.name: aidb.update_semantic_kb_context
functions.summary: Stores your own description of a KB, such as business terms or how its tables relate.

functions.name: aidb.semantic_kb_stats
functions.summary: Returns entity counts and pending-change status for a KB.

functions.name: aidb.delete_semantic_kb
functions.summary: Deletes a KB, its indexed metadata, and its business glossary.

functions.name: aidb.semantic_kb_search
functions.summary: The composite entry point: runs the per-source ranked searches (schema metadata, relationships, curated semantic aliases, query history, and business glossary concepts) and fuses them into one ranked list with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF).

functions.name: aidb.get_metadata
functions.summary: The broadest schema search: returns columns, tables, and views together with full metadata.

functions.name: aidb.get_entity_definitions
functions.summary: Matches tables and views only.

functions.name: aidb.get_column_definitions
functions.summary: Returns just the matching column and table definitions — the leanest result, useful as compact grounding for SQL generation.

functions.name: aidb.search_by_comment
functions.summary: Matches only the natural-language `COMMENT ON` text attached to schemas, tables, and columns.

functions.name: aidb.semantic_kb_subgraph
functions.summary: Returns a question's neighborhood: seeds from the search hits and adds the relationships around them, so you get the joins connected to a question, not just the entities.

functions.name: aidb.semantic_kb_import_concepts
functions.summary: Writes a business glossary document into the term store of a KB and embeds its new and changed concepts.

functions.name: aidb.list_relationships
functions.summary: Lists recorded relationships, optionally filtered.

functions.name: aidb.find_join_path
functions.summary: Finds a route between two tables, ranked shortest first, then by confidence.

functions.name: aidb.suggest_joins
functions.summary: Lists every relationship one hop from a given set of tables, in either direction.

functions.name: aidb.add_relationship
functions.summary: Records a relationship by hand.

functions.name: aidb.add_relationship_as_agent
functions.summary: Records a relationship the same way as `aidb.add_relationship()`, but always sets `source = 'agent'`.

functions.name: aidb.delete_relationship
functions.summary: Deletes a relationship.

functions.name: aidb.relationship_drift
functions.summary: Detects and repairs drift on hand-added relationships when a named column is renamed or dropped.

functions.name: aidb.update_semantic_kb_history_filter
functions.summary: Sets the roles whose statements query history doesn't learn from, and deletes the statements those roles already contributed.

functions.name: aidb.import_query_history
functions.summary: Reads `pg_stat_statements` to find joins the application runs but the schema never declared.

functions.name: aidb.relationship_candidates
functions.summary: Lists relationship candidates derived from query history that aren't yet known relationships.

functions.name: aidb.accept_relationship_candidates
functions.summary: Accepts one or more relationship candidates, making them routable.

functions.name: aidb.classify_query_history_statement
functions.summary: Explains why a single statement would or wouldn't be used by `import_query_history()` — the quickest way to understand an import that ingested less than expected.

functions.name: aidb.list_query_history
functions.summary: Lists the normalized statements, relations touched, and join predicates recorded by `import_query_history()`, most-run first.

functions.name: aidb.add_comment_to_object
functions.summary: Writes a `COMMENT ON` for a table, view, column, or constraint, and reconciles every KB that indexes the object so the new text is searchable immediately.

functions.name: aidb.remove_comment
functions.summary: Clears a description.

functions.name: aidb.list_proposed_comments
functions.summary: Lists comment writes queued for review under curation.

functions.name: aidb.resolve_object_comment
functions.summary: Approves or rejects a proposed comment.

functions.name: aidb.update_semantic_kb_curation
functions.summary: Turns the comment-review queue on or off for a KB.

functions.name: aidb.semantic_kb_audit
functions.summary: Lists recorded semantic KB operations.

functions.name: aidb.semkb_audit_prune
functions.summary: Deletes the audit records of one knowledge base that are older than a given age.

functions.name: aidb.semantic_kb_health_report
functions.summary: Returns one row that summarizes the health of a semantic KB.

functions.name: aidb.semantic_kb_coverage_gaps
functions.summary: Lists live tables, views, and columns that have no description embedding, ordered by entity type and then by name.

functions.name: aidb.semantic_kb_stale_objects
functions.summary: Lists objects that have DDL events queued but not yet re-embedded, with the longest-waiting first.

functions.name: aidb.semantic_kb_orphan_relationships
functions.summary: Lists relationships whose relation endpoint, junction endpoint, or a listed column no longer exists in the live catalog, including `retired` relationships.

functions.name: aidb.semantic_kb_alias_diagnostics
functions.summary: Lists the semantic aliases of a semantic KB that aren't verified against the live catalog, ordered by alias name.

functions.name: aidb.semantic_kb_object_usage
functions.summary: Reports how often each object appeared in recorded search results and alias executions, and when it last did.

functions.name: aidb.create_semantic_alias
functions.summary: Creates a named, parameterized SQL query paired with a natural-language description, and embeds the description in every semantic KB that owns the query's schema(s).

functions.name: aidb.search_semantic_aliases
functions.summary: Searches aliases by natural-language query, embedding the query once per distinct model among the searched KBs so results stay dimension-safe and de-duplicated to the best match per alias.

functions.name: aidb.execute_semantic_alias
functions.summary: Runs an alias by name, substituting its parameters.

functions.name: aidb.get_semantic_aliases
functions.summary: Lists every alias, with its name, description, query text, and parameter count.

functions.name: aidb.get_semantic_alias
functions.summary: Gets one alias by name, with its full definition: description, query text, and parameter list.

functions.name: aidb.update_semantic_alias
functions.summary: Updates an alias.

functions.name: aidb.delete_semantic_alias
functions.summary: Deletes an alias by name.

groups.name: Pipelines
groups.description: Reference documentation for the EDB AI pipelines API: types, views, core functions, and configuration helpers.

functions.name: aidb.create_pipeline
functions.summary: Creates a new pipeline with a source, up to 10 sequential processing steps, and an optional destination.

functions.name: aidb.update_pipeline
functions.summary: Updates the auto-processing settings for an existing pipeline.

functions.name: aidb.delete_pipeline
functions.summary: Deletes a pipeline and its configuration.

functions.name: aidb.run_pipeline
functions.summary: Manually triggers a pipeline to execute immediately, regardless of its `auto_processing` mode.

functions.name: aidb.get_pipeline_metrics
functions.summary: Returns current processing statistics for a pipeline.

functions.name: aidb.chunk_text_config
functions.summary: Configures a `ChunkText` step to split text into smaller segments.

functions.name: aidb.summarize_text_config
functions.summary: Configures a `SummarizeText` step to summarize text using a language model.

functions.name: aidb.ocr_config
functions.summary: Configures a `PerformOcr` step to extract text from images using a model.

functions.name: aidb.html_parse_config
functions.summary: Configures a `ParseHtml` step to extract text from HTML content.

functions.name: aidb.pdf_parse_config
functions.summary: Configures a `ParsePdf` step to extract content from PDF documents.

functions.name: aidb.knowledge_base_config
functions.summary: Configures a `KnowledgeBase` step to compute and store embeddings.

functions.name: aidb.knowledge_base_config_from_kb
functions.summary: Configures a `KnowledgeBase` step to attach a pipeline to an existing knowledge base rather than creating a new one.

functions.name: aidb.inference_config
functions.summary: Builds a JSONB configuration object for runtime inference settings.

functions.name: aidb.vector_index_hnsw_config
functions.summary: Configures an HNSW index (pgvector).

functions.name: aidb.vector_index_ivfflat_config
functions.summary: Configures a pgvector IVFFlat index.

functions.name: aidb.vector_index_chord_hnsw_config
functions.summary: Configures a VectorChord HNSW index.

functions.name: aidb.vector_index_chord_vchordq_config
functions.summary: Configures a VectorChord `vchordq` index.

functions.name: aidb.vector_index_hsphere_optimized_config
functions.summary: Configures an HSphere Optimized index.

functions.name: aidb.vector_index_disabled_config
functions.summary: Disables automatic vector index creation.

functions.name: aidb.get_error_logs
functions.summary: Returns error log entries for a pipeline, with optional filters.

functions.name: aidb.get_error_log_summary
functions.summary: Returns aggregated error counts for a single pipeline, grouped by step, operation, and category.

functions.name: aidb.get_all_error_summaries
functions.summary: Returns the same rollup as `aidb.get_error_log_summary()` but across all pipelines at once.

functions.name: aidb.clear_error_logs
functions.summary: Deletes specific error log entries by ID.

functions.name: aidb.requeue_pipeline_errors
functions.summary: Deletes the targeted record-level error log entries and marks their source records dirty on the pipeline's state surface.

groups.name: Agents
groups.description: API reference for AIDB agent management, conversations, and structured output helpers.

functions.name: aidb.create_agent
functions.summary: Registers a new agent.

functions.name: aidb.update_agent
functions.summary: Updates an existing agent.

functions.name: aidb.delete_agent
functions.summary: Deletes an agent by name.

functions.name: aidb.agent_converse
functions.summary: Runs an agent's reasoning loop against a prompt and returns its answer.

functions.name: aidb.start_agent_session
functions.summary: Mints a fresh conversation id for a named agent, ahead of the first `agent_converse` call that will use it.

functions.name: aidb.get_conversation
functions.summary: Retrieves a conversation's messages — every user prompt and final answer, in chronological order.

functions.name: aidb.get_message
functions.summary: Retrieves one message's plain-text contents by id.

functions.name: aidb.output_field
functions.summary: Builds one field of an agent's structured output schema.

functions.name: aidb.output_type
functions.summary: Builds a complete structured output schema from one or more fields.

functions.name: aidb.create_agent_plugin
functions.summary: Registers a new plugin.

functions.name: aidb.update_agent_plugin
functions.summary: Updates an existing plugin.

functions.name: aidb.delete_agent_plugin
functions.summary: Deletes a plugin by name.

functions.name: aidb.get_mcp_agents
functions.summary: Lists agents as MCP tool descriptors.

groups.name: Tools
groups.description: API reference for AIDB's tool catalog, SQL tool registration, and MCP server management.

functions.name: aidb.create_sql_tool
functions.summary: Registers a parameterized SQL query as a tool.

functions.name: aidb.delete_tool
functions.summary: Deletes a SQL tool or an MCP server registration by name (removing every tool the server advertised along with it).

functions.name: aidb.import_mcp_tools
functions.summary: Registers an external MCP server and imports the tools it advertises.

functions.name: aidb.refresh_mcp_tools
functions.summary: Re-fetches an already-registered MCP server's advertised tools and refreshes the cache.

functions.name: aidb.set_mcp_shared
functions.summary: Changes whether every member of `aidb_users` can call a registered MCP server's tools.

functions.name: aidb.get_mcp_tools
functions.summary: Converts every currently registered tool (native, SQL, and MCP alike) into an MCP `tools/list`-shaped descriptor.

functions.name: aidb.run_tool
functions.summary: Runs any tool in `aidb.tools` by name, whether native, SQL, or MCP, and returns its result.

functions.name: aidb.tool_param
functions.summary: Builds one SQL tool parameter.

functions.name: aidb.tool_params
functions.summary: Combines one or more `aidb.tool_param()` results, or (called with no arguments) declares an empty parameter list.

groups.name: Purposes
groups.description: API reference for the purpose registry, the purpose change history, and the governance-related configuration parameters.

functions.name: aidb.create_purpose
functions.summary: Creates a purpose.

functions.name: aidb.update_purpose
functions.summary: Changes a purpose's role or description.

functions.name: aidb.delete_purpose
functions.summary: Deletes a purpose.

functions.name: aidb.prune_purpose_history
functions.summary: Deletes the history rows of superseded purpose versions that ended before a cutoff.

functions.name: aidb.backfill_purpose_history
functions.summary: Adds the missing current-version history row for each purpose restored from a dump taken before AIDB 7.10.0.

groups.name: Agent memory
groups.description: API reference for the aidb_memory functions, catalog views, and configuration parameters.

functions.name: aidb_memory.init
functions.summary: Initializes a namespace and prepares it to store and retrieve memories.

functions.name: aidb_memory.add
functions.summary: Persists agent turns as an event so that they can be retrieved later as memory.

functions.name: aidb_memory.status
functions.summary: Reports the status of a memory event: `ACCEPTED`, `PROCESSING`, `READY`, `SKIPPED`, or `FAILED`.

functions.name: aidb_memory.search
functions.summary: Searches the stored memories and returns the entries that match a natural-language query.

functions.name: aidb_memory.list_memories
functions.summary: Lists the memories stored in agent memory.

functions.name: aidb_memory.delete
functions.summary: Removes memories when they must be deleted for compliance, privacy, or retention reasons.

functions.name: aidb_memory.session_start
functions.summary: Opens a conversation, or resumes one, and returns the handoff left by the previous conversation in the same scope.

functions.name: aidb_memory.session_get
functions.summary: Returns a conversation's history in order, within an optional character budget.

functions.name: aidb_memory.session_end
functions.summary: Closes a conversation and stores a handoff that describes it.

groups.name: Observability
groups.description: Reference for AIDB's built-in OpenTelemetry tracing: the aidb_otel schema, who can read it, storage format, functions, background workers, and every attribute AIDB emits.

functions.name: aidb.run_otel_retention_cleanup
functions.summary: Manually triggers a full retention cleanup pass, deleting rows older than `aidb.otel_cleaner_retention_days` from all three `aidb_otel` tables, in the same bounded batches the cleaner background worker uses.
